 WEST SEATTLE WEATHER: Major power outage hits thousands, trees and wires down
 November 7, 2026 
 |    
   29 COMMENTS 
  |   Utilities | West Seattle news 
 8:44 PM : Hasn’t hit the City Light map just yet but we’re getting power outage reports from Arbor Heights.
 8:46 PM: It’s on the map now – almost 5,000 customers out. 911 is getting calls from people who heard a transformer/fuse blow. This happened during a burst of strong wind and rain.
 9:45 PM: Huge apologies for the hourlong gap. We lost power (and are still out) here in Upper Fauntleroy, but we have ample backups for power and internet – unfortunately the server – which is NOT physically nearby – crashed too.
 We’ve continued monitoring police radio and suffice it to say, it’s dangerous out there – closed streets with wires and/or trees down – though the weather has calmed somewhat, that huge blast a little over an hour ago is all it took to knock tens of thousands out here and elsewhere. 
 9:54 PM : Avalon and West Marginal are among the arterials with tree trouble. For Avalon, texter says “The road is taped off and blocked in front of Luna Park Café.” Newest wired-down call is in North Admiral, 46th and Massachusetts.
 10:06 PM: City Light is making some progress – the total number out in their service area has dropped from the 40,000s to the 30,000s. 
 10:53 PM: Third hour. If you’re out too, remember – don’t open the fridge!
 11:04 PM: Since the mapped outage zone appeared to include Morgan Junction, we had a WSB team member take a look. Thriftway (which is usually open until midnight) has lights on. South of there, McDonald’s and the gas station/minimart are out.
 11:21 PM: Just got our first word of some restoration, 6900 block of California SW in Gatewood. … Others too. SCL map says the original 4K+ outage is down to 1,753 customers. (We’re still out – part of a 149-customer outage that started about 15 minutes after everyone else.)
 12:06 AM: No 4-digit outages left on the peninsula. 367 in Delridge and 419 in the Arroyos are among the biggest clusters left
 2:21 AM: New tree trouble, this time at Delridge and Thistle, according to police radio. And the wind has revved back up again.
 3:56 AM: Eighth hour now for the hundreds of West Seattleites still out, us included. Our screenshot of part of the City Light map shows the largest remaining outage areas on the peninsula (around the region, SCL still has about 20,000 to reconnect). As for the weather, the wind advisory now has expired, and the rain is the big news for some hours to come.
 5:36 AM: Just got ours back.
